# CLI reference

<!-- Generated by scripts/gen-cli-docs.sh from `corral <cmd> --help`. Do not edit by hand. -->

Generated from `corral 0.1.0`. Every command also accepts
`--root <ROOT>` (the directory containing `.corral/`; default: discovered from the current directory).

```text
Project management control plane for agentic coding, inside herdr

Usage: corral [OPTIONS] [COMMAND]

Commands:
  plan            Submit, review and approve implementation plans independently of code review
  build-identity  Print the immutable landed identity embedded by a post-land install
  hooks           Inspect, reconcile and retry durable project post-land operations
  run             Persist run progress, checkpoints, waits, decisions and resume receipts
  queue           Authorize, pause, and inspect the coding dispatch queue
  wait            Wait for the first matching event, starting at EOF by default (timeout exits 124)
  up              Start or attach the board; also the default when no command is given
  doctor          Check the terminal engine and workspace setup
  init            Create .corral/ in --root or the current directory
  stats           Outcome evidence grouped by profile (default), model, kind, project or task
  new             Create a task and print its id
  list            List tasks (done/dropped hidden unless --all; --done lists finished tasks, newest first)
  search          Search tasks across all statuses in relevance order
  show            Show one task
  comment         Append a comment to a task, optionally sending it to the agent
  move            Move a task to another status
  edit            Open the task file in $EDITOR
  route           Explain which profile would run a task without starting it
  dispatch        Start an agent run for a task
  reply           Send a reply to the task's agent
  unstick         Terminate a stuck foreign foreground process after confirmation, then retry the pending reply
  done            Mark the run finished and move the task to Review
  criteria        Manage explicit owner-reviewed criterion manifests
  evidence        Record and inspect criterion-linked worker assertions
  gate            Run the review gate commands in the current run's worktree (in a herdr pane)
  review-run      Start an independent review of the current run (a reviewer profile in its own pane, or the PM)
  verdict         Record a review verdict on the current run
  dashboard       Configure recurring living-dashboard report tasks
  artifact        Manage artifacts
  pin             Pin a task (T-042) or artifact (T-042:R1:<file>) so it is one step away
  unpin           Remove a pin (by ref or pin number)
  pins            List pins in order
  open            Open a pin (number or ref) or any task/artifact ref with its viewer: [viewers], else $CORRAL_OPENER, else terminal-browser for HTML inside herdr, else the system opener (WSL-aware)
  review          Show the review summary of a task
  approve         Merge the run and mark the task Done
  changes         Request changes on a task in Review
  retry           Start a fresh run for a task
  discard         Discard the current run and drop the task
  jump            Focus the task's herdr pane
  sync            Reconcile tasks with herdr and advance the review autopilot (--watch: keep syncing every 2 s, headless)
  autopilot       Turn the review autopilot on or off, or show it and the tasks it is driving
  hook            herdr plugin event hook: run sync once, always exit 0
  pm              Open or focus the PM pane
  focus-board     Go back to this workspace's board pane, opening one only if none is running (the back-to-board key)
  board           Open the board TUI
  capture         Open the capture popup
  artifacts       Open the artifact finder
  settings        Open the settings screen
  harness         Installed agent harnesses, their versions and models
  plugin          Manage the herdr plugin
  skill           Print the corral agent skill (SKILL.md), or install it for your agents
  config          Read, change and check .corral/corral.toml
  help            Print this message or the help of the given subcommand(s)

Options:
      --root <ROOT>  Workspace root (the directory containing .corral/); default: discovered from the current dir
  -h, --help         Print help
  -V, --version      Print version
```

## `corral plan`

```text
Submit, review and approve implementation plans independently of code review

Usage: corral plan [OPTIONS] <COMMAND>

Commands:
  cancel   End a planner session while retaining submitted plans and review history
  submit   Snapshot a plan (YAML metadata + markdown) against the current task spec
  show     Inspect current and historical plan snapshots and verdicts
  review   Review a plan without starting implementation or taking a coding slot
  verdict  Record a plan-only verdict; callbacks must include their exact attempt
  policy   Set the task's plan requirement, or inherit workspace/project review policy
  help     Print this message or the help of the given subcommand(s)

Options:
      --root <ROOT>  Workspace root (the directory containing .corral/); default: discovered from the current dir
  -h, --help         Print help
```


## `corral run`

```text
Persist run progress, checkpoints, waits, decisions and resume receipts

Usage: corral run [OPTIONS] <COMMAND>

Commands:
  wait        Register an explicit event wait (version 1 JSON); never executes monitor commands
  decision    Ask the owner an exact question with a requested action (version 1 JSON)
  resume      Record an event or answered decision receipt; never resends or relaunches work
  progress    Read identity and state, or replace execution progress from a JSON file
  checkpoint  Read identity and state, or save a guarded checkpoint from a JSON file
  help        Print this message or the help of the given subcommand(s)

Options:
      --root <ROOT>  Workspace root (the directory containing .corral/); default: discovered from the current dir
  -h, --help         Print help
```

## `corral queue`

```text
Authorize, pause, and inspect the coding dispatch queue

Usage: corral queue [OPTIONS] <COMMAND>

Commands:
  add     Enqueue only, preserving explicit routing and base overrides
  remove  Dequeue and exclude from automatic Ready admission
  pause   Pause all new coding dispatches, independently of review autopilot
  resume  Resume coding dispatches; sync drains the queue
  admit   Opt exactly this project into Ready admission (or revoke with --off)
  list    List candidates in dispatch order with their waiting reasons
  help    Print this message or the help of the given subcommand(s)

Options:
      --root <ROOT>  Workspace root (the directory containing .corral/); default: discovered from the current dir
  -h, --help         Print help
```

### `corral queue add`

```text
Enqueue only, preserving explicit routing and base overrides

Usage: corral queue add [OPTIONS] <ID>

Arguments:
  <ID>

Options:
      --profile <PROFILE>  Profile (harness + model + effort preset) for this run [alias: --agent]
      --root <ROOT>        Workspace root (the directory containing .corral/); default: discovered from the current dir
      --model <MODEL>      Model override for this run
      --effort <EFFORT>    Effort level override for this run (valid levels depend on the harness)
      --base <BASE>
      --headless
  -h, --help               Print help
```

```text
Usage: corral queue remove [OPTIONS] <ID>
```

## `corral wait`

```text
Wait for the first matching event, starting at EOF by default (timeout exits 124)

Usage: corral wait [OPTIONS]

Options:
      --for <KINDS>                  Task and configuration event kinds to await (comma-separated) [default: done,needs_me,stuck,blocked,escalated,config_changed,config_invalid] [possible values: done, needs_me, stuck, blocked, escalated, config_changed, config_invalid]
      --root <ROOT>                  Workspace root (the directory containing .corral/); default: discovered from the current dir
      --task <TASK>
      --project <PROJECT>
      --timeout <TIMEOUT>            Maximum wait, e.g. 30m, 2h, 10s (default: unlimited)
      --json
      --since <SINCE>                Replay events at or after this RFC3339 timestamp, unless --after-offset is given
      --after-offset <AFTER_OFFSET>  Resume immediately after this byte offset
      --print-cursor                 Add offset and resumable cursor to JSON; append cursor=<JSON> to human output
  -h, --help                         Print help
```

```text
Create a task and print its id

      --ready
      --body <BODY>
      --body-file <BODY_FILE>

      --priority <PRIORITY>
```

## `corral list`

```text
List tasks (done/dropped hidden unless --all; --done lists finished tasks, newest first)

Usage: corral list [OPTIONS]

Options:
      --query <QUERY>      Search all statuses in relevance order; explicit filters still apply
      --root <ROOT>        Workspace root (the directory containing .corral/); default: discovered from the current dir
      --status <STATUS>
      --project <PROJECT>
      --all
      --done               Only Done tasks, newest finished first, with finish date and the sha their approval landed
      --since <SINCE>      With --done: only tasks finished in the last N hours, days or weeks (e.g. 7d)
      --json
      --columns <COLUMNS>  Print only these comma-separated columns: id, status, project, title or any board card field (cost, tokens, ...)
  -h, --help               Print help
```

## `corral dashboard`

```text
Configure recurring living-dashboard report tasks

Usage: corral dashboard [OPTIONS] <COMMAND>

Commands:
  set     Authorize recurring dispatch of a report task (also resumes a paused schedule)
  show    Show a task's schedule as JSON (null means absent)
  pause   Pause future occurrences; already queued/running work remains authorized
  remove  Remove future recurrence; already queued/running work remains authorized
  help    Print this message or the help of the given subcommand(s)

Options:
      --root <ROOT>  Workspace root (the directory containing .corral/); default: discovered from the current dir
  -h, --help         Print help
```

### `corral dashboard set`

```text
Authorize recurring dispatch of a report task (also resumes a paused schedule)

Usage: corral dashboard set [OPTIONS] --interval-secs <INTERVAL_SECS> --next-due <NEXT_DUE> <ID>

Arguments:
  <ID>

Options:
      --interval-secs <INTERVAL_SECS>
      --root <ROOT>                    Workspace root (the directory containing .corral/); default: discovered from the current dir
      --next-due <NEXT_DUE>            Explicit first/next due timestamp, e.g. 2026-10-16T12:00:00Z
      --authorize-dispatch             Grant permission for sync to enqueue successive runs automatically
  -h, --help                           Print help
```

## `corral artifact`

```text
Manage artifacts

Usage: corral artifact [OPTIONS] <COMMAND>

Commands:
  set-tier  Override an artifact's inferred importance tier
  gc        Deduplicate artifacts and apply the configured retention policy
  add       Snapshot a file as a task artifact
  list      List artifacts, most important first (keep, normal, transient)
  show      Print an artifact formatted for reading (Markdown, JSON, TOML, logs, diffs, CSV)
  help      Print this message or the help of the given subcommand(s)

Options:
      --root <ROOT>  Workspace root (the directory containing .corral/); default: discovered from the current dir
  -h, --help         Print help
```

### `corral artifact set-tier`

```text
Override an artifact's inferred importance tier

Usage: corral artifact set-tier [OPTIONS] <REFERENCE> <TIER>

Arguments:
  <REFERENCE>
  <TIER>       [possible values: keep, normal, transient]

Options:
      --root <ROOT>  Workspace root (the directory containing .corral/); default: discovered from the current dir
  -h, --help         Print help
```

### `corral artifact gc`

```text
Deduplicate artifacts and apply the configured retention policy

Usage: corral artifact gc [OPTIONS]

Options:
      --dry-run      Preview actions and bytes saved without changing any files
      --root <ROOT>  Workspace root (the directory containing .corral/); default: discovered from the current dir
      --yes          Apply the policy without prompting; required for a real run
      --json
  -h, --help         Print help
```

```text
  <PATH>

      --root <ROOT>    Workspace root (the directory containing .corral/); default: discovered from the current dir
      --title <TITLE>

```

```text
List artifacts, most important first (keep, normal, transient)
```

## `corral config`

```text
Read, change and check .corral/corral.toml

Usage: corral config [OPTIONS] <COMMAND>

Commands:
  diff      Show the latest recorded semantic config change, or all changes since a timestamp
  history   Show recorded config changes and invalid-config diagnostics in log order
  get       Print a setting by dotted key (e.g. limits.running, projects.app.path); defaults included
  set       Change a setting in place, keeping comments; refused when the result would be invalid
  validate  Check corral.toml and list every problem (exits non-zero when invalid)
  path      Print the path of corral.toml
  help      Print this message or the help of the given subcommand(s)

Options:
      --root <ROOT>  Workspace root (the directory containing .corral/); default: discovered from the current dir
  -h, --help         Print help
```
